listing.name: Forza Motorsport 4 (Forza Motorsport 4 Recompiled)
listing.summary: Attach the prepared official Forza Motorsport 4 Windows alpha player for the exact Europe GOTY Disc 1 inputs. Preserve its explicit game/user/cache roots and independent originals; current native-player packaging supersedes older builder-first instructions.

steps.title: Prepare the exact independently owned inputs
steps.instruction: Use a complete player/components you are independently permitted to use and your own Europe GOTY Disc 1, title 4D530910/media 42C67824. Required originals are default.xex (15,187,968 bytes; SHA256 B34DFB88978819CCCDA6DAFD755E7139970A58FBF6707DFBCBA06846857F52BD), XMediaFacade_default.xex (2,662,400; 2E82A8D08A59E79F4D68E68B744C2872855BFDD583EB39AD0A9C54E5B3FA1492), SpeechFacade_default.xex (2,138,112; 49D506A2F8556836943D8BAB3A50B6CD3877524500509EF462FB6E9802F2F4BF), and the complete matching Media tree. These are individual XEX hashes, not whole-disc hashes. Finish upstream preparation first; no originals, compiler, helper or game are executed here.

steps.title: Keep the actual native player package
steps.instruction: The inspected official v0.1.0-alpha.2 player ZIP contains AMD64 fm4.exe, matching SpeechFacade/XMediaFacade native DLLs, runtime libraries and notices. Its release/package README explicitly provides a ready-to-run player: older tagged builder-first/source-kit instructions do not mean this package requires a developer compiler or SDK. Keep the entire package. Its public SDK binding is f16992c92e610c2d71773994436b442d9946f4e1; no private build or full/fast experiment is qualified. Package requirements are Windows 11 x64, AVX2 and D3D12.

steps.title: Attach the native player with its real roots
steps.instruction: Select fm4.exe and the full package directory as working directory. Match the published Launch FM4.bat native command using --game_data_root="absolute existing game folder" --user_data_root="absolute existing user folder" --cache_root="absolute existing user/cache folder", substituting the actual prepared absolute paths and retaining upstream long-path spelling when necessary. The batch file checks all three XEXs before synchronously running this native player. Review the exact intent and request Play separately; do not select a compiler, helper, source kit or diagnostic probe.

steps.title: Preserve originals, profiles and writable game data
steps.instruction: Keep game/Media and XEXs, user/ profiles/saves/cache, fm4.toml, logs, actual external roots and independent recovery copies. Packaged allow_game_relative_writes=true means the prepared game tree is not promised read-only. Optional independently owned Disc 2 marketplace content uses disc2-content/ and upstream startup installation into user data; this guide imports nothing. Never replace the only original or live profile with a fresh package.

steps.title: Retain limits and upstream maintenance
steps.instruction: Keep GPLv3 project and ReXGlue, Xenia, FFmpeg, runtime and other component notices; they do not license original game assets. The selected baseline uses D3D12 ROV, full readback and synchronous host copies; upstream reports heavy scenes near 30 FPS and fresh-profile blank car thumbnails. Binary/package inspection does not prove a race, save round trip or stable 60 FPS. Quit normally before upstream replacement, retain recovery and review/relink changed bytes. Managed install/update/rollback/backup/deletion, Supported and native/physical acceptance are not offered.

warnings: Use the actual ready-to-run player rather than the older source kit. Keep explicit game/user/cache paths, independent originals and profiles; this alpha can write into its prepared game tree.
